title: RWB-S5-E1011-APP: the asset slice of RWB-E1-011 has no source for its dependency lists, its ACE-side read, its quality objects, its rights, its run cadence and the owning row of the asset table, and the data-lake and Power BI target of the legacy key is removed
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4 dependency classes, R5.5 DP table and R3 source precedence; split_plan.json slice RWB-S5-E1011-APP (H, C, I and X all empty); Work Package B2-S5-026 story line; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13 (S5 row), 15 (P1 and P9 contracts), 19 (rwb-asset IN and OUT), 29, 37, 41 and 44; FSD S5 Assets and auction A1.4, A2.1.3.1 (VR-S5-001-1) and A2.6.3.2 (field catalog over v_ace_npa_asset, v_ace_collateral and v_ace_asset); TSD S5 Assets and auction T2, T3.1, T3.2 and T6.1; FSD P1 A2.2 (DP06 Collateral and assets, WEEKLY MON 08:00) and A2.11.2 (REC-05 compared on business key, count and amount); legacy RWB-E1-011 sections 2, 3, 4 steps 10 to 12, 10, 12 and 19
section: Metadata (Depends on (build), Contract dependencies); Sections 2, 3, 4, 7, 10, 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.6, 12.7 and 13
description: One combined row for the story. (1) Dependencies: the DP table adds seven platform CONs (RWB-PLT-E1027-CON for DP-03, RWB-PLT-E1042-CON for DP-06, RWB-PLT-E1043-CON for DP-07, RWB-PLT-E1071-CON for DP-10, RWB-PLT-E1047-CON for DP-14, RWB-PLT-E1044-CON for DP-15 and RWB-PLT-N001-CON for DP-19) and two rwb-case contracts (RWB-P3-E1042-CON and RWB-P3-E1043-CON), while the plan sets H and C to None, so the story cannot state its build or contract dependency from the plan. (2) The ACE side of the check: FSD S5 A2.6.3.2 names recovery.v_ace_npa_asset, v_ace_collateral and v_ace_asset as the module integration point, while Architecture v5 slides 13, 29, 37 and 45 give the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views to rwb-source-data alone and give the S5 row no call to P1; the two sources conflict and the R3 precedence puts Architecture v5 first. (3) The quality objects: TSD S5 declares asset, listing and asset_sale only and carries no run, result, break, quality or report object, no run state set, no check name and no read operation for a quality result. (4) The report target: the legacy publish step writes reconciliation and data-quality extracts through INT-19 to a data lake for a Power BI report, and DP-17 and ADR-018 remove the lake, the INT-19 and INT-20 adapters and the Power BI data set. (5) The rights: the legacy story declares Platform administration R for its job listing, while TSD S5 T6.1 declares only the Asset and disposal column, so the module matrix is silent on the two quality reads. (6) The table ownership: the Ownership Map's S5 table row names asset_sale and listing, while TSD S5 T3.1 declares asset as an S5 object, and the column of the asset row that holds the ACE asset key is not named. (7) The cadence: the legacy run is a daily batch step of JOB-04, DP-10 makes it a Temporal Schedule, and no source gives its cron or its alert groups.
evidence: split_plan.json slice RWB-S5-E1011-APP: H, C, I, X empty, wave 1, lane L-S5-A, patterns DP01, DP02, DP03, DP05, DP06, DP07, DP10, DP11, DP14, DP15, DP17, DP19; Architecture v5 slides 13, 29, 37, 41, 44 and 45; FSD S5 A2.6.3.2 and TSD S5 T3.1, T3.2, T6.1; FSD P1 A2.2 and A2.11.2; legacy RWB-E1-011 sections 2, 3, 4, 10, 12 and 19
area: S5 rwb-asset: quality run, schema and rights
owner_role: TechX and the data steward and data product owner
proposed: Confirm at the wave-1 design gate: the platform release train as the source of the seven platform CONs; the rwb-source-data contract as the only ACE-side read, with the FSD S5 view names read as the product behind it; the three quality tables, check names and read operations as the service design; the two quality reads in Platform administration right R; the asset table as an S5 object read in rwb_asset; and a daily Schedule with a cron and alert groups set as configuration.
